name: dsh-extension-hub
description: Extension Hub for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): manage skills, MCP servers and plugins from the DSH Web settings page — list / create / edit / delete / enable-disable, import from Claude and Codex, manage official & third-party plugins, discover and install GitHub dsh-plugin repositories, and keep them updated. Ships a durable dual-face Cordis plugin (host gateway + browser settings section) and a dependency-free CLI.
